title.en: Empowering the President to Determine the Terms and Conditions of Power Contracts of the Government With Aluminum Smelter Projects and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Upon the recommendation of the Minister of Energy and Minister of Industry, the President is
hereby empowered to determine the rates and other terms and conditions for power contracts of aluminum
smelters with the Government or any agency or instrumentality thereof, including the National Power
Corporation or any other government-owned or controlled corporation;

Notwithstanding any provision of existing laws to the contrary, including Republic Act No.
6395, as amended, the President may for the purposes hereof, authorize the National Power Corporation to set
such rates and other terms and conditions, as may be determined by the President, for power contracts with
aluminum smelters; or authorize the National Development Company, either alone or in joint venture with the
National Power Corporation, to establish a separate corporation which shall supply the power requirements of
aluminum smelters under such rates and other terms and conditions determined by the President.

All laws, decrees, orders, proclamations, instructions, or rules and regulations, or parts thereof
which are inconsistent herewith are hereby modified and/or repealed accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
